A cottage row stretches along a curved lane, every wraparound porch dressed for trick-or-treat with hanging ghost-shaped luminaries, pumpkin step-arrangements, and corn-husk wreaths on each door, window candlelight glowing amber and warm, the lane fading into a soft mist-wrapped woodline at the far end.

A clocktower square erupts in mid-costume-parade festivity, rainbow-colored confetti and orange bunting streaming from every lamppost and rooftop edge, paper streamers looping across the cobblestones, the grand clocktower face glowing amber at the top, cottages with flung-open shutters receding into the cheerful background haze.

A barn-and-silo farmstead is dressed up as a friendly hayride fair, a straw-bale-lined wagon track curving through the foreground, the great red barn strung with bat-shaped fairy lights in the midground, a tall wooden silo wrapped in spiral orange bunting standing against a wide indigo harvest-moon sky.

A lighthouse-village dusk gathering centers on a whitewashed lighthouse whose beam sweeps warm amber arcs across a pumpkin-lit stone dock, carved jack-o-lanterns lining every pier post in the foreground, lantern-lit fishing cottages hugging the curved harbor road in the midground, a full amber moon rising over open water.

A stone-well courtyard is ringed with an elaborate display of carved pumpkins for a harvest ring-toss game, the mossy well itself topped with a cheerful grinning gourd, wooden game stands draped in orange-and-black bunting in the midground, tall shuttered townhouses with glowing attic windows encircling the background.

A treehouse village cascades through ancient oaks, rope bridges connecting platforms strung with glowing paper-ghost lanterns, carved pumpkins perched on every railing and branch fork, warm candlelight spilling from tiny porthole windows, the forest floor below carpeted in red and gold leaves lit by lantern glow.

A mill-pond village glows at dusk, lantern-lit rowboats drifting lazily across dark mirrored water, a large floating pumpkin raft strung with fairy lights anchored in the midground, a mossy watermill wheel turning slowly beside a stone mill house, warmly lit village rooftops reflecting in the still pond beyond.
